Export Listing.name: Export Listing
Export Listing.format:
If you would like to download the {Item (Singular)} records for reporting purposes, you can use the export feature to download a Microsoft Excel file with the {Item (Singular)} records.
\"template:{Open Listing Template Name}"\
1) Above the table, click \"uisvg:primary:export:Export"\.
1) An Excel file will be downloaded to your device.

\"box:tip:Exporting a subset:
To export only certain {Item (Singular)} records, filter your results first, then export."\
